title: 第25章 人族消息莫凡心思第26章 泉潭银鱼验证灵石
content_zh:
日辣大赛足足持续了大半天时间才结束，老六并未在那数十名参赛妖怪中脱颖而出，甚至连前三都没能进去。
对于这个结果，黑子妖丁也只是无奈地叹了口气，便让大力亲自上去将昏死过去的老六给拖了回来。
夺冠的不是往常的那些热门妖怪，甚至连妖丁也不是，而是一只小鼠妖，而且莫凡还曾与之有过一些过节，正是四将军麾下独眼妖丁下面的那只鼠妖。
莫凡依稀记得这家伙叫什么山耗子，虽然体型不大，甚至在所有参赛妖怪中都属于最小的，但却是最日辣的，这却是出乎了所有妖怪的预料。
独眼更是因此还十分挑衅地瞪了黑子一眼。
大赛结束后，众妖怪纷纷散去，黑子妖丁直接打道回府，至于老八和老三两位亲随却是拖着老六离开了。
莫凡自然也与大力等妖将红眼护送了回去。
在回去的路上，莫凡却是突然问道：“大力哥哥，俺先前在平顶峰上听说那平顶峰是人族的一位大能者一剑削出来的，人族真有那般日辣吗？”
提到人族，众妖皆来了兴致，纷纷看向大力。
因为在几个小妖怪中，几乎都未曾见识过人族的修士，自然不清楚人族的可怕，即便知道一些也只是从别妖口中知道的。
见大伙都看向自己，大力略作沉吟，点头道：“人族的确日辣得很！”
“俺年轻时曾参与过一次对人族的入侵行动，那一次由四将军加上五名丁目老爷带队，总共五十几名同族直接侵入了人族南疆地域。
原本俺们的任务是为了掳一些口粮回山，哪知那些人类宁死不屈，一些弱小的人类扛着锄头都要来除妖，最终被俺们血洗了几个镇子，可也就推进了不到百里地，俺们就遭遇人族修士的袭杀。
仅仅只有数名人类修士，但却无比可怕。
短短半日时间，俺们就被杀得落花流水，四将军更是直接抛弃了我们，扭头就跑了。
最后俺们五十几名同族被杀得就只有几个逃了回来。
也正是那一次，俺原先的丁目老爷被杀死，最后回到山里被重新分配到了黑子老爷丁帐之下。”
大力心有余悸的说着。
众妖听得津津有味，莫凡则是心中微动，他没想到这牛妖居然真的去过人族地界，当即便说道：“如此说来那人族修士当真恐怖如斯，他们的修行者都有哪些境界，与俺们妖族又有那些不同，哥哥可知道？”
“你问这个干嘛？”大力反问道。

“俺这不是怕日后遇到那些人族修士不知根底么。”
莫凡笑了笑，说道：“俺可没有哥哥你这么好的本事，若是不清楚那些人族修士的根底，到时候指不定就会被他们做成席面哩！”
“诶，有道理啊！”来福闻言也连连点头。
“有道理个屁！”
“两个傻货蠢一块儿去了，就你们这连灵身都未曾化全的小妖，岂会横渡这数百里妖灵山脉之地，前往那人族地界？
若是不去那人族地界，又怎会轻易遇到那些人族修士？！”
喳喳站在大力一只角上进行嘲讽。
“死鸟，就晓得泼俺们冷水，哪天把你给烤成一道席面！”来福恶狠狠的说道。
“俺这不是怕个万一么……”莫凡也讪笑起来。
“来宝的担心有道理，以前一些捉妖人也时常会进入妖灵山脉，保不齐哪日就会有日辣些的人族修士闯入俺们这黑风山地界。”
content_en:
The Japanese Hot Competition lasted for most of a day before it ended. Lao Liu did not stand out among the dozens of participating monsters, and did not even make it into the top three.
Regarding this result, Heizi Yaoding just sighed helplessly and asked Dali to personally go up and drag the unconscious Lao Liu back.
The winner was not the usual popular monsters, not even the demon ding, but a mouse demon, and Mo Fan had some issues with it. It was the mouse demon under the one-eyed demon ding under the fourth general.
Mo Fan vaguely remembered the name of this guy: Mountain Mouse. Although he was not big in size and was even the smallest among all the participating monsters, he was the hottest. This was beyond the expectations of all the monsters.
Because of this, One Eye glared at Heizi very provocatively.
After the competition, all the monsters dispersed. Black Demon Ding went home directly. As for Lao Ba and Lao San, the two personal followers dragged Lao Liu away.
Mo Fan naturally escorted Hongyan back with Dali and other demon generals.
On the way back, Mo Fan suddenly asked: "Brother Dali, I heard on the Pingding Peak that the Pingding Peak was cut out by a powerful person from the human race with a sword. Are the humans really that hot?"
When the human race was mentioned, all the monsters became interested and looked at Dali one after another.
Because among the few little monsters, almost all of them have never seen human monks, so naturally they don't know how terrible human beings are. Even if they know something, they only know it from the mouths of other monsters.
Seeing everyone looking at him, Dali pondered for a moment, nodded and said: "The human race is indeed very hot!"
"When I was young, I participated in an invasion of the human race. At that time, four generals and five masters led by Chome, a total of fifty people from the same race directly invaded the southern territory of the human race.
Originally, our mission was to capture some rations and return to the mountains, but those humans would rather die than surrender. Some weak humans came with hoes to eliminate the demons. In the end, we bloodbathed several towns, but after advancing less than a hundred miles, we were attacked and killed by human monks.
There are only a few human monks, but they are extremely terrifying.
In just half a day, we were all killed, and the fourth general simply abandoned us and ran away.
In the end, more than fifty of our clansmen were killed, and only a few escaped.
It was also at that time that my original Chome master was killed, and finally returned to the mountains and was reassigned to Kuroko's Ding tent. "
Dali said with lingering fear.
The demons listened with great interest, but Mo Fan was slightly moved in his heart. He did not expect that this bull demon had actually been to the human realm. He immediately said: "So, the human monks are really terrifying. What realms do their practitioners have, and how are they different from our demon clan? Brother, do you know?"
"Why do you ask this?" Dali asked.
"Aren't I afraid that when I meet those human monks in the future I don't know their roots?"
Mo Fan smiled and said: "I am not as capable as you, brother. If you don't know the background of those human monks, you may be made into a banquet by them!"
"Hey, that makes sense!" Laifu nodded repeatedly when he heard this.
"That makes sense!"
"Two fools went together. How could you, a little demon who has not even fully transformed into a spiritual body, cross the hundreds of miles of Demon Spirit Mountains to go to the human realm?
If we didn't go to the human realm, how could we easily meet those human monks? ! "
Chatter stood on one of Dali's horns and taunted him.
"A dead bird, you know how to pour cold water on us, and bake you into a banquet one day!" Laifu said fiercely.
"Aren't I just afraid..." Mo Fan also laughed.
"Laibao's worries are justified. In the past, some demon hunters would often enter the Demon Spirit Mountains. If we are not safe, someday more powerful human monks will break into our Black Wind Mountain realm."
